name: mujoco_swarm6
title: Six-drone swarm
description: Takeoff, two-level grid, rotating circle and landing. Every drone runs the CF-Drone firmware model and is closed through the ground position controller with inter-drone separation.

name: mujoco_square
title: Square, one drone
description: 0.6 m square at 0.4 m, 2.5 s per side, minimum-jerk segments.

name: mujoco_yaw_align
title: Heading alignment (mocap vs. onboard yaw)
description: Both drones start with a 25 deg onboard heading error and 1 deg/s drift (no magnetometer). Drone 1: commands rotated by YawAlign. Drone 2: raw mocap-frame commands.

name: genesis_square
title: Square, one drone (Genesis)
description: Same mission and controller as the MuJoCo square, on the Genesis rigid-body backend.
